_title: Tahmin Meleği - İddaa | Match Oracle from the Witch’s Cauldron
_description: Tahmin Meleği - İddaa: think of a football match, rub the fate cauldron, and read a single prophecy on the parchment. Match result, over/under, BTTS and more — for entertainment only.
hero_title:
Tahmin Meleği - İddaa
Think of a Match, Get a Prophecy
hero_lead: Tahmin Meleği - İddaa is an entertainment app that serves a match prophecy from a fate cauldron on a stormy night. Hold a match in your mind, rub the cauldron, and a single pick appears on the parchment.
how_desc: One phone, one ritual: think, rub, read.
how_1_d: The storm breaks, the witch arrives and whispers: think of a match and rub the cauldron.
how_2_d: Rub the fate cauldron with your finger. It boils, lightning speaks.
how_3_d: When the cauldron speaks, a parchment rises and the prophecy is written.
how_4_d: A single random sign from match result, over/under, BTTS and other markets.
markets_desc: The cauldron randomly produces picks from real football betting markets.
screens_desc: Stills from the witch, the cauldron ritual and the parchment prophecy.
s_1_d: The witch arrives on a stormy night.
s_2_d: No need to type team names.
s_3_d: The fate cauldron starts to boil.
feat_desc: For pre-match fun and “what did the witch say?” chats.
f_1_d: Lightning, a boiling cauldron, a witch’s laugh and parchment animation.
f_2_d: Match result, over/under, BTTS, double chance, handicap, corners and more.
f_3_d: No menu maze. Think, rub, read your prophecy.
f_4_d: Jump into the ritual without signing up or typing teams.
warn_desc: Prophecies are generated at random; they are not match analysis, statistics or betting advice. Gambling can cause financial loss. Not suitable for users under 18.
cta_desc: Tahmin Meleği - İddaa is the newest entertainment app from the Sogepps family.
arts_desc: Guides and game ideas around Tahmin Meleği.
